look: A premium dark, in the brand's red, cream and yellow, with look C face badges and look B line draw-ons

storyboard.what: Hook: 'Have you ever wondered...' typed word by word, burger, little restaurant, globe, people who know the brand
'Meet McDonald's': orb, arches rise, the name slides out, light rays
'An American multinational fast-food restaurant chain' under the logo
'Known for its...': Burgers, Fries, Chicken, Beverages, Desserts cards pop on each word
'quick-service dining': stopwatch draws, speed streaks, diners
'The story began in 1940': year rolls 1900 to 1940
'two brothers, Richard and Maurice McDonald': face badges, name tags on their names
'opened their first restaurant in San Bernardino, California': restaurant draws, pin drops
'the man who transformed it into a global business'
'was Ray Kroc': founder cutout rises with the name tag
'In 1955 he opened his first McDonald's restaurant': year rolls, restaurant draws
'an ambitious franchise expansion model': lines run out to new restaurants
'thousands of restaurants across more than 100 countries': globe, pins, 100+ counter
'it's not just about food': 'food' struck through
'franchising, digital ordering': hub nodes, the phone's Order button tapped
'home delivery, marketing, customer experience, localised menus': each node on its word
'From the iconic Big Mac'
'to McDelivery': the scooter rides in
'an entire global food-service ecosystem': the menu and people orbit the logo
'a worldwide brand phenomenon!': logo burst, light rays
